description: Test helper functions and mocks for webhook handling in the BlueBubbles project, including request creation, dispatch, registration, and setup functions.

methods.name: createMockAccount
methods.description: Creates a mock BlueBubbles account with default or overridden configuration.

methods.name: createProtectedWebhookAccountForTest
methods.description: Creates a mock account with a specified password for testing webhook authentication.

methods.name: createNewMessagePayloadForTest
methods.description: Generates a mock 'new-message' payload with optional data overrides.

methods.name: createTimestampedNewMessagePayloadForTest
methods.description: Generates a timestamped 'new-message' payload.

methods.name: createMessageReactionPayloadForTest
methods.description: Creates a mock 'message-reaction' payload with optional data overrides.

methods.name: createTimestampedMessageReactionPayloadForTest
methods.description: Creates a timestamped 'message-reaction' payload.

methods.name: createMockRequest
methods.description: Constructs a mock IncomingMessage with specified method, URL, body, headers, and remote address.

methods.name: createMockRequestForTest
methods.description: Creates a mock request with default or specified parameters.

methods.name: createRemoteWebhookRequestParamsForTest
methods.description: Generates request parameters for a remote webhook request.

methods.name: createPasswordQueryRequestParamsForTest
methods.description: Creates request parameters with a password query string for testing.

methods.name: createLoopbackWebhookRequestParamsForTest
methods.description: Creates request parameters for a loopback (local) webhook request.

methods.name: createHangingWebhookRequestForTest
methods.description: Creates a mock request that simulates a hanging webhook (no response).

methods.name: createMockResponse
methods.description: Creates a mock ServerResponse object with methods to capture output.

methods.name: flushAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for microtasks to complete, used to flush event loop.

methods.name: createWebhookDispatchForTest
methods.description: Dispatches a webhook request and returns response and promise.

methods.name: dispatchWebhookRequestForTest
methods.description: Dispatches a webhook request with optional async flush.

methods.name: dispatchWebhookPayloadForTest
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a webhook payload for testing.

methods.name: expectWebhookStatusForTest
methods.description: Asserts the status and body of a webhook response.

methods.name: expectWebhookRequestStatusForTest
methods.description: Creates a request from parameters and asserts response status and body.

methods.name: trackWebhookRegistrationForTest
methods.description: Tracks and sets unregister function for webhook registration.

methods.name: registerWebhookTargetForTest
methods.description: Registers a webhook target with test parameters.

methods.name: registerWebhookTargetsForTest
methods.description: Registers multiple webhook targets for testing.

methods.name: setupWebhookTargetForTest
methods.description: Sets up a webhook target with core, account, and config for testing.

methods.name: setupWebhookTargetsForTest
methods.description: Sets up multiple webhook targets for testing.
